about: Every source this site draws on, with how well each link has been checked. Status 'confirmed': the link was opened on the checked date and the content matched. 'unopened': the link comes from an official index or search, but no one has opened it yet; a person should open it once. 'no-link': listed as background reading, with no public link recorded yet.
